atoms.text: This is Jesse, a writer of several short, but very informative, articles. In order to write her own texts, she often uses examples from other writers who have covered the same topic. Let’s find out who wrote the texts she used as inspiration in her latest article.

hint.text: Abstract art uses colours, patterns and shapes in a way that looks different to everything else in our everyday world.
hint.label: Abstract art

atoms.text: The painting, Flowers on Holiday by Segrado Amicili is famous for its lively colours and abstract patterns. In an interview, the artist said that he wanted to express his mixed feelings about his childhood. The famous critic Petra Paikovsky, however, argued that the usage of colours and patterns is nothing but a random combination that is not particularly appealing.

instruction.text: Whose texts did Jesse use as inspiration for her own text?

hint.text: There is more than one correct answer.

feedback.end: Jesse read two articles before writing her own text. The first was an interview with the painter Segrado Amicili and the second by the critic Petra Paikovsky.

atoms.text: The fashion industry is one of the most powerful in the world. According to researchers, in the last 30 years, the amount of money the average Brit spent on fashion more than tripled. Having a closer look at fashion magazines explains this modern trend. Fashion magazines often encourage their readers to buy more clothes to keep up with the latest trend.

Many research journals criticise this behaviour because it promotes a wasteful lifestyle. For example, researchers found that many people wear their clothes only a few times, throwing them away once they are out of fashion.

instruction.text: Which texts did Jesse use as inspiration for her own text?

hint.text: There is more than one correct answer.

feedback.end: Jesse read two articles before she wrote her own text: one from a fashion magazine and one from a research journal about the fashion industry.
